Scoped to its own // <svg> so several graphs can share an HTML page. It goes in a CDATA // section, so it must never contain the three characters that end one. // // Frames are <g class="f"> with data-x, data-w (samples), data-d (depth) // and, in a diff, data-a and data-b (samples before and after). function name(g) { return g.querySelector('title').textContent.replace(/ \((?:[0-9]+ samples|before ).*$/, ''); } function info(g) { R.querySelector('.fg-info').textContent = g.querySelector('title').textContent; } function h(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>'); } function pct(n) { return (100 * n / TOTAL).toFixed(1) + '%'; } function link(loc) { var m = loc.match(/^(.*):([0-9]+)$/), base = null, p; if (!m) return h(loc); if (/^src\//.test(m[1]) && SRC) { base = SRC; p = m[1]; } else if (/^crystal\//.test(m[1]) && CRYSTAL) { base = CRYSTAL + '/src'; p = m[1].slice(8); } return base ? '#c23b2b' : '#3561c2') + '">' + (dd >= 0 ? '+' : '') + dd.toFixed(1) + ' percentage points</b>' + (a == 0 ? ' (only after)' : b == 0 ? 'inlined ' + h(r[1]) : '') + '</td></tr>'; }); s += '</table>'; } else s += '<span style="color:#777">No source lines: kernel, libc or libgc frame, a label, or no llvm-symbolizer/addr2line where the profile was taken.</span>'; el.innerHTML = s; }
